description: Mobiliers de distribution d'eau potable et non potable - Données géographiques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Paris. Vector-type data describing various drinking and non-drinking water distribution points: wallace fountain, fountain terminal, valve, mouth... Example(s) of re-use(s) of data: - Website and iPhone App. Coverage: Ville de Paris. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking and non-drinking water distribution furniture — Geographical data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Paris. Its keywords include urbanisme. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, HTML, JSON. The listing shows 2016-03-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
